claims.claim: During its third‑quarter earnings call, Reddit CEO Steve Huffman highlighted a significant drop in traffic that comes from Google Search.
claims.bestSource: Reddit Stock Tumbles as CEO Says Google Search Referrals Were 'Choppy,' Pushes Users to Its App - Yahoo Finance
claims.evidence: Reddit Inc. is encouraging more direct engagement through its app instead of finding the platform through Alphabet Inc.'s Google Search after CEO Steve Huffman said search referrals turned "choppy" during the second quarter, sending shares tumbling in extended trading. Reddit CEO Steve Huffman told CNBC in an interview that the company's shrinking search-referral traffic from Google went "down meaningfully in this quarter" due to the "shift to AI mode and AI overviews." The traffic decline played a big role in Reddit's planned efforts to require people to become logged-in users.
